item.text: I’m synthesizing the 2024 evidence already collected for 6B.4 and will keep it to claim-level items with explicit positives and negatives.

**6B.4 Research Note: Bola Ahmed Tinubu in 2024**

**Bottom line:** mixed, leaning positive on technocratic staffing and formalized delivery structures, but with a meaningful patronage counterexample and limited evidence that those structures produced broad social-service gains in 2024.

**Accepted claims**
- **President Tinubu establishes comprehensive economic coordination and planning system for Nigeria** | State House | 2024-03-27 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/  
  Tinubu created PECC/EET structures centered on the finance minister and CBN governor, adding economists and private-sector figures to emergency economic coordination. This is strong evidence of technocratic management rather than pure patronage.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **President Tinubu appoints management team of the Nigerian Education Loan Fund** | State House | 2024-04-05 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-management-team-of-the-nigerian-education-loan-fund/  
  The education-loan institution was staffed with “qualified Nigerians” to stand up a long-horizon social investment program. This supports merit-based management of a social-service instrument.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **President Tinubu establishes national education data system and approves skill development for all levels of education, teachers’ training and support nationwide** | State House | 2024-04-18 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-national-education-data-system-and-approves-skill-development-for-all-levels-of-education-teachers-training-and-support-nationwide/  
  The education package emphasized out-of-school children, teacher training, and a national data system, which indicates an attempt to manage education delivery through administrative systems and trained professionals.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **President Tinubu approves takeoff of consumer credit scheme** | State House | 2024-04-24 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-approves-takeoff-of-consumer-credit-scheme/  
  The scheme was presented as a policy tool for homes, vehicles, education, and healthcare rather than a patronage payout. It is indirect evidence for a more institutionalized social-support approach.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **President Tinubu directs reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement** | State House | 2024-06-15 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/  
  Procurement reform is direct evidence of trying to reduce rent-seeking in public purchasing, which matters for how social-service funds are managed.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **President Tinubu appoints new director-general of the Bureau of Public Enterprises** | State House | 2024-06-15 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-new-director-general-of-the-bureau-of-public-enterprises/  
  The appointee was described as a financial expert and chartered accountant, which is a clear technocratic staffing signal.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2

- **President Tinubu appoints new board of Family Homes Fund** | State House | 2024-07-02 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-new-board-of-family-homes-fund/  
  The board was explicitly framed as qualified Nigerians expected to deploy expertise in real-estate-sector development. This is relevant to housing and shows professionalized institutional staffing.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **World Bank approves new financing for Nigeria to improve health outcomes, safety of dams and irrigation services** | World Bank | 2024-09-26 | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/09/26/world-bank-approves-new-financing-for-nigeria-to-improve-health-outcomes-safety-of-dams-and-irrigation-services  
  The package targeted health, basic education governance, and resilience infrastructure, implying service-delivery systems rather than pure patronage allocation. External support also suggests some confidence in institutional implementation.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **Supporting Nigeria’s homegrown reforms: New World Bank financing for inclusive growth and revenue diversification** | World Bank | 2024-06-13 | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/13/supporting-nigeria-homegrown-reforms-new-world-bank-financing-for-inclusive-growth-and-revenue-diversification  
  The Bank said the reform package aimed to create fiscal space for public services and scale up support to vulnerable households. This is strong external validation that the policy design was not purely patronage-driven.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

**Negative / limiting evidence**
- **Tinubu under fire for appointing son-in-law head of housing agency** | BusinessDay | 2024-02-21 | https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/  
  The son-in-law appointment to the Federal Housing Authority is the clearest patronage signal in the 2024 record. It directly cuts against a clean technocratic-only reading.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown** | Reuters via GPB | 2024-05-09 | https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown  
  Detaining a journalist over corruption reporting weakens the broader accountability environment around public spending and service delivery. It is indirect, but it undercuts claims that the administration was cleanly professionalized.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

- **Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting** | CPJ | 2024-10-03 | https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/  
  Continued use of cybercrime charges against journalists suggests a punitive information environment, which makes it harder to monitor whether social-service funding and staffing are actually benefiting ordinary people.  
  QIDs: 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3

**Search gap**
- Direct evidence on whether Tinubu’s administration systematically staffed **health, water, sanitation, elderly care, disability services, and minority-targeted programs** with professionals is thin.
- Most available evidence is indirect: appointment notices, procurement reform, and broad social-investment announcements.
- I found stronger evidence for **technocratic intent** than for **measured service-delivery outcomes** in 2024.

If you want, I can do the same compact note for the next lens.
